import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import re

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load training data
with open("./input/train/train.json", "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)

# Load test data
with open("./input/test/test.json", "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)

# Convert to DataFrame
train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

# Define numeric features
numeric_features = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
]

# Extract numeric features with fillna
X_numeric = train_df[numeric_features].fillna(0)
X_test_numeric = test_df[numeric_features].fillna(0)

# Create text features - separate title and text for TF-IDF
train_text = (
    train_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
    + " "
    + train_df["request_title"].fillna("")
)
test_text = (
    test_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
    + " "
    + test_df["request_title"].fillna("")
)

# TF-IDF vectorizer
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=300, ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=2, stop_words="english"
)
X_text = tfidf.fit_transform(train_text)
X_test_text = tfidf.transform(test_text)

# Basic text features
train_df["text_length"] = train_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").apply(len)
train_df["title_length"] = train_df["request_title"].fillna("").apply(len)
train_df["text_word_count"] = (
    train_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").apply(lambda x: len(str(x).split()))
)
train_df["has_edit"] = (
    train_df["request_text_edit_aware"]
    != train_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
).astype(int)

# IMPROVED: Expanded politeness and gratitude features with community/altruism words
politeness_words = [
    "please",
    "thank",
    "thanks",
    "sorry",
    "appreciate",
    "grateful",
    "kind",
    "thankful",
    "wonderful",
    "amazing",
    "lucky",
    "blessed",
    "generous",
    "beautiful",
    "nice",
    "helpful",
    "supportive",
    "caring",
    # NEW: Community and altruism-focused words from best solution (0.6909 AUC)
    "community",
    "friend",
    "love",
    "joy",
    "smile",
    "kindness",
    "generosity",
    "support",
    "help",
    "blessing",
    "heart",
    "together",
    "share",
    "give",
    "generous",
    "blessed",
    "amazing",
    "wonderful",
    "beautiful",
    "nice",
]


def count_politeness_words(text):
    text_lower = str(text).lower()
    count = 0
    for word in politeness_words:
        # Use word boundary matching to avoid false positives
        pattern = r"\b" + re.escape(word) + r"\b"
        count += len(re.findall(pattern, text_lower))
    return count


train_df["politeness_count"] = (
    train_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").apply(count_politeness_words)
)

# NEW: Punctuation features
train_df["question_mark_count"] = (
    train_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").apply(lambda x: str(x).count("?"))
)
train_df["exclamation_count"] = (
    train_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").apply(lambda x: str(x).count("!"))
)
train_df["avg_word_length"] = (
    train_df["request_text_edit_aware"]
    .fillna("")
    .apply(lambda x: np.mean([len(w) for w in str(x).split()]) if str(x).split() else 0)
)

# NEW: Subreddit engagement features
train_df["subreddit_ratio"] = train_df[
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request"
].clip(0, 50)
train_df["raop_engagement"] = (
    train_df["requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request"] > 0
)
train_df["raop_engagement"] = train_df["raop_engagement"].astype(int)
train_df["comment_to_post_ratio"] = train_df[
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request"
] / (train_df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"] + 1)
train_df["raop_comment_ratio"] = train_df[
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request"
] / (train_df["requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request"] + 1)

# Apply same features to test set
test_df["text_length"] = test_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").apply(len)
test_df["title_length"] = test_df["request_title"].fillna("").apply(len)
test_df["text_word_count"] = (
    test_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").apply(lambda x: len(str(x).split()))
)
test_df["has_edit"] = (
    test_df["request_text_edit_aware"] != test_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
).astype(int)

# IMPROVED: Politeness features for test with same expanded word list
test_df["politeness_count"] = (
    test_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").apply(count_politeness_words)
)

# NEW: Punctuation features for test
test_df["question_mark_count"] = (
    test_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").apply(lambda x: str(x).count("?"))
)
test_df["exclamation_count"] = (
    test_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").apply(lambda x: str(x).count("!"))
)
test_df["avg_word_length"] = (
    test_df["request_text_edit_aware"]
    .fillna("")
    .apply(lambda x: np.mean([len(w) for w in str(x).split()]) if str(x).split() else 0)
)

# NEW: Subreddit engagement features for test
test_df["subreddit_ratio"] = test_df["requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request"].clip(
    0, 50
)
test_df["raop_engagement"] = test_df["requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request"] > 0
test_df["raop_engagement"] = test_df["raop_engagement"].astype(int)
test_df["comment_to_post_ratio"] = test_df[
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request"
] / (test_df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"] + 1)
test_df["raop_comment_ratio"] = test_df[
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request"
] / (test_df["requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request"] + 1)

# Combine all features
X_train = np.hstack([X_numeric.values, X_text.toarray()])
X_test = np.hstack([X_test_numeric.values, X_test_text.toarray()])

# Add engineered features
X_train_eng = (
    train_df[
        [
            "text_length",
            "title_length",
            "text_word_count",
            "has_edit",
            "politeness_count",
            "question_mark_count",
            "exclamation_count",
            "avg_word_length",
            "subreddit_ratio",
            "raop_engagement",
            "comment_to_post_ratio",
            "raop_comment_ratio",
        ]
    ]
    .fillna(0)
    .values
)
X_test_eng = (
    test_df[
        [
            "text_length",
            "title_length",
            "text_word_count",
            "has_edit",
            "politeness_count",
            "question_mark_count",
            "exclamation_count",
            "avg_word_length",
            "subreddit_ratio",
            "raop_engagement",
            "comment_to_post_ratio",
            "raop_comment_ratio",
        ]
    ]
    .fillna(0)
    .values
)

X_train = np.hstack([X_train, X_train_eng])
X_test = np.hstack([X_test, X_test_eng])

# Target variable
y = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].astype(int)

# Stratified train-validation split
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Train RandomForest model with same hyperparameters as best solution
model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=150, max_depth=10, min_samples_split=5, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1
)
model.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val_split)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_split, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_df["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": test_pred}
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
